scope.objective: forward makespan; analytic L1 plus existing LightOP calibration; blocking HTAE
scope.shared_parameters: tie_shared_params=True in every method; no unmodeled remote tied weights
scope.budget_contract: 64 by default actual unique complete-plan model evaluations, including both native initializations and infeasible calls
scope.references: eight predefined legal uniform/half-layer plans, never search seeds; no Exact oracle
scope.capacity_contract: free=physical total; cap75=75% of unfused single-card forward peak; synthetic, not training
scope.cpu_wall_time_scope: diagnostic; two model processes may run concurrently; not an algorithm speed benchmark
